name: Komatsu Yuuki
source:
"[i]Hey there, Fujimiya-saaaan. How about coming to help out the Student Council?[/i]"

The current Student Council President of Hinamori Academy.
She particularly values Fujimiya Rinne for her diligence and dedication.
Normally a serious, dependable, and capable president, she occasionally shows a playful side.
As a fair and sensible leader, she enjoys an excellent reputation among the students.

Class: Hinamori Academy, Class 3-1
Height: 159cm
Birthday: January 15th
Likes: Cute girls, efficiency
Dislikes: Loud people, people who start conversations by shooting others down
